sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law – unitary national state; legal framework rooted in the Code of Commerce (Decreto 410 de 1971), special corporate statute Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S.), and European-continental juridical doctrine; constitutional jurisprudence is binding but ordinary case law is not stare decisis.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Alianza del Pacífico, 2011) with investment chapter
Colombia–Netherlands Investment and Double Taxation Agreement (in force 2021)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. incorporation); Law 526 of 1999 (creation of UIAF – Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero); Law 1121 of 2006 (anti-terrorism financing); Law 2195 of 2022 (integrity and corruption prevention); Law 2155 of 2021 (beneficial ownership mandate); Decree 1068 of 2015, arts. 2.9.3.18.1 et seq. (single regulatory decrees); DIAN Resolution No. 164 of 2022 and DIAN Resolution No. 13 of 2025 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB); Superintendencia de Sociedades External Circular 030 of 2022 (SAGRILAFT regime); Law 1437 of 2011 (CPACA) for administrative appeals.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (confidential filing with DIAN; accessible to UIAF, Superintendencia de Sociedades, tax authority and enabled prosecutorial bodies; not publicly searchable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of each non-resident corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia acceded via Decree 1457 of 2001; Convention in force since 22 March 2001)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney executed by the foreign corporate shareholder appointing the Colombian incorporator/legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or equivalent public officer in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport or national identity document of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin or Colombian Notaría once the UBO is present in Colombia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign notarized copies; consular legalization not required for Hague member states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn Beneficial Ownership Declaration (Declaración de Beneficiario Final) for each UBO meeting the 25% threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian Notaría or authorized declaration submitted to DIAN within the RUB filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization before Colombian notary (no apostille required for internally issued instruments)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, director, legal representative, and authorized signatory against the OFAC/SDN list, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, EU consolidated list, and Colombian national watchlists circulated by UIAF, DIAN, and the Consejo de Seguridad Nacional. The S.A.S. must adopt a written SAGRILAFT manual covering Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) detection, sanctions filtering, transaction monitoring, risk matrix, and annual certification to the Superintendencia de Sociedades under External Circular 030 of 2022. Enhanced due diligence is required for any UBO of non-resident origin and when cross-border payments are settled through U.S. payment rails (Stripe, Authorize.Net) that themselves enforce OFAC compliance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social – RUES (https://www.rues.org.co and transaction portal rue.suit.gov.co), processed by the local Cámara de Comercio; for Bogotá the operating portal is https://www.ccb.org.co.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in the Latin alphabet and must be pronounceable/readable in Spanish. Foreign-language names are admitted only where transliterated to Spanish script; the corporate name must include the ending token 'S.A.S.' or 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada'. The name must be distinctive and not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company name or protected trademark; misleading names that suggest a different legal form or an unlicensed regulated activity are rejected.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Fondo de Inversión (requires prior financial authorization)
Policía / Fuerzas Militares (reserved for public institutions)
Salud (requires prior Ministry of Health approval in healthcare-related names)
Energía / Telecomunicaciones (sensitive tokens requiring prior ministerial statement in regulated sectors)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The RUES system does not permit extension of an approved name reservation; the incorporation must be formalized within 30 calendar days, otherwise the name is released and a new reservation must be filed. In the event of rejection, the applicant may file a recurso de reposición within 10 business days before the registry director of the issuing Cámara de Comercio and, in subsidiarity, a recurso de apelación to the Superintendencia de Sociedades, governed by Articles 74–77 of Law 1437 of 2011 (CPACA). A parallel second-choice name reservation is strongly advised to avoid operational delay and registry downtime.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only as the registered domicile for administrative and correspondence purposes in non-industrial S.A.S. operations. A subscription-box merchandising business under ISIC 4791 must maintain a physical and verifiable address for inventory storage, fulfillment, consumer-service contact, and supervision by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC). A virtual office may be registered, but any warehouse or fulfillment center must be independently covered by local zoning (uso de suelo) and operational permits.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% – quantified as low-to-moderate risk. Cámara de Comercio and DIAN do not conduct routine unannounced inspections of newly incorporated S.A.S. companies; however, consumer complaints, VAT inconsistency flags, or a SAGRILAFT audit request from UIAF may trigger an on-site verification. For subscription-box activity with recurring physical deliveries, logistics-chain inspections by municipal authorities remain a credible but non-routine contingency.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUES name reservation and clearance fee (non-refundable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (RUES platform)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. incorporation deed (estatutos), initial shareholder resolution, and appointment of legal representative
Notarial authentication of private instrument (autenticación notarial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Notaría (Notary Fifty-Three of Bogotá, illustrative)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Merchant registration (matrícula mercantil) and RUES matriculation – 0.7% on subscribed capital, illustrated at assumed COP 40,000,000 (≈ USD 9,750) subscribed capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory percentage on subscribed capital under Decreto 410 de 1971 and national development plan tariff scheme

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of incorporation and legal existence registration (certificado de existencia y representación legal), digital copy
NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) pre-registration filing with DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory – no state fee for NIT issuance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional tax/legal service for DIAN NIT pre-registration filing, validation, and tax classification under Régimen Ordinario
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (hourly or fixed filing fee)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO Register (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB) initial filing with DIAN
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance advisor (DIAN filing itself is free)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for compliance preparation and submission

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille of foreign parent incorporation certificate and special power of attorney (two instruments)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in the shareholder's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark, including courier and consular coordination

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator registered with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Colombia

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation enhanced due diligence on UBOs, directors and legal representative (PEP, OFAC, UN and Colombian sanctions screening)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance provider and corporate due-diligence counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for third-party database screening and manual review

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and adoption of initial SAGRILAFT / AML-CFT compliance manual for the S.A.S.
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (USD 220–350 depending on structure)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of commercial books (shareholders register and board minutes book) before Cámara de Comercio

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Law 1258 of 2008), Articles 1-5 and 17-21 governing the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) regime; subsidiarily the Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110-126 and 353-377; complemented by Decreto 1074 de 2015 (business law regulation) and Decreto 2364 de 2010 (digital signature recognition).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá), acting through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) platform, with registration data synchronized to the DIAN for NIT issuance.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (private incorporation instrument executed by the shareholders); must be elevated to a public deed (Escritura Pública) before a Notary when real property is contributed to the company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum authorized, subscribed, or paid-in capital (Article 4, Ley 1258/2008). The bylaws set the capital terms; the initial subscribed capital must be paid within the term fixed in the bylaws, which may not exceed two years from incorporation (Article 5, Ley 1258/2008). No escrow or blocked bank account is required by Colombian law for S.A.S. formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION - RESOLUTION No. 001
The Sole Founding Shareholder of [COMPANY] S.A.S. hereby certifies that, on [date], the following resolutions were adopted under Law 1258 of 2008:
1. The subscription of the authorized share capital by the founding shareholder is ratified.
2. The registered office is established at [address], adopted as the legal seat for corporate and tax notifications.
3. [NAME] is appointed Legal Representative (Presidente), and [NAME] as Substitute Legal Representative, with the powers vested by the bylaws.
4. The Legal Representative is authorized to complete the commercial registration before the Chamber of Commerce, the RUT assignment before DIAN, and the opening of corporate bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Availability Verification (Certificado de Homonimia)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social - Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the Chamber's virtual office, complete the 'consulta de homonimia' form with up to three proposed corporate names, and submit the request electronically. The system cross-references the RUES database and issues a favorable 'Certificado de Homonimia' confirming that the proposed name is available; retain the certificate for the subsequent registration file.
required_dossiers: Formulario de consulta de homonimia (application form)
Up to three proposed corporate names
Valid national ID or passport of the applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the search identifies a conflicting or similar name, select alternative names and re-submit; if the desired name is blocked due to similarity only, file a reasoned written objection with the Chamber's commercial registry department within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of the Incorporation Instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders for execution; Notaría Pública when real property is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the S.A.S. bylaws containing the legal minima under Article 17, Law 1258/2008: corporate name ending in 'S.A.S.', domicile, duration, corporate purpose (recurring subscription-box merchandising and related logistics), authorized/subscribed/paid-in capital (no statutory minimum), share classes, governance and legal representation rules, and arbitral remedies. Execute the document with all shareholders, using an electronic signature validated under Decreto 2364/2010 or before a notary if real estate is contributed.
required_dossiers: Valid ID or passport of each shareholder
RUT or foreign tax identification certificate of each shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the reviewing attorney or notary identifies non-compliant clauses, amend the bylaws, re-execute the document, and re-present; supplementary verifications requested by the notary must be cured before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal Review and Pre-Approval by the Chamber of Commerce (Pre-rúbrica)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social - Legal Review and Registration Department (Calificación y Registro)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed incorporation instrument together with the favorable homonymy certificate into the Chamber's virtual office for legal review. The Chamber verifies mandatory clauses and legality of the corporate purpose; after the review concludes favourably, the file is marked ready for commercial registration.
required_dossiers: Signed incorporation instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
Proof of identity and legal capacity of the signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber issues an 'auto de devolución' (deficiency notice), correct the indicated clauses and re-upload the revised document within the granted term (generally five business days) to avoid file closure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registry (RUT) and NIT Assignment before DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - automated RUES/DIAN interface and MUISCA portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon completion of the Chamber registration, the RUES/DIAN interface automatically assigns the NIT and generates the RUT. The legal representative then logs into the MUISCA portal, updates the RUT with ISIC 4791 / NAICS 454110 classification, the warehouse address, and the array of tax obligations (corporate income tax, VAT and ICA), and activates the electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) certification.
required_dossiers: Chamber registration record transmitted via RUES
Legal representative's ID and digital signature certificate
Corporate address and business activity data (ISIC 4791)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN does not match the RUT data automatically, request the Chamber to resend the registration record or file an RUT correction form at a DIAN service point with supporting identification and the certified registration summary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Enrollment and Issuance of the Existence Certificate (Registro Mercantil y Matrícula)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social - Commercial Registry Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Formulario de Matrícula with the definitive company data and pay the applicable chamber tariff (derechos de inscripción and form fees) via PSE or bank payment. The Registry officer enrolls the company in the Registro Mercantil and issues the 'Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal', which evidences incorporation, legal representation, and the assigned NIT.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of chamber fees and tariffs
Approved version of the bylaws after legal review
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If inconsistencies are detected between the shareholders' identification data and the certified records, submit a 'corrección a registro' request with supporting identity documents and settle the re-registration tariff to reactivate the file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Activation: Banking, Electronic Invoicing and Digital Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Supervised financial entities (banks); DIAN; authorized certification authorities (e.g., Certicámara)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the existence certificate, open a corporate bank account with the legal representative and obtain a digital signature certificate from an authorized certification authority. Configure the electronic invoicing system with an authorized software provider or DIAN's free platform, and declare the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) information when required by the bank under Decreto 830/2021.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Bylaws and ID of the legal representative; UBO declaration for banking compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the financial institution requests enhanced due diligence documents, supply the requested UBO and source-of-funds information within the bank's stated term; if the electronic invoicing authorization is rejected, re-apply after correcting the RUT obligations in MUISCA.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial licensing board applies to ISIC 4791/NAICS 454110; municipal obligations are administered by the Secretaría de Hacienda (ICA registration) and the Secretaría de Planeación or equivalent (land-use certificate) of the company's domicile.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Uso de Suelo (land-use certificate for warehousing/logistics) and Registro de Industria y Comercio (ICA) - a sectoral operating license is not mandated for subscription-box merchandising.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the local competent environmental authority (Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente in Bogotá or the regional Corporación Autónoma Regional/CAR for other municipalities)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from the full EIA regime - warehousing, packing and parcel dispatch are low-impact activities under Decreto 1076/2015; no Licencia Ambiental or formal EIA report is required; only municipal environmental registration and compliance with basic operational standards apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: domestic-type discharges only; sewer connections must comply with Resolution 0631/2015 limits (pH 6.0-9.0; BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L; TSS ≤ 200 mg/L). Solid waste: segregated collection under Resolution 2184/2019 (white, black and green containers) and proper disposal of cardboard and plastic packaging; progressive restriction of single-use plastics under Law 2232/2022. Air: no significant point-source emissions; storage and handling must avoid VOC releases, using low-VOC adhesives and packaging materials, and maintain ambient air quality values of Resolution 2254/2017.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: 'Concepto Técnico de Seguridad Humana y Protección contra Incendios' from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos covering the warehouse premises, with annual reinspection where occupant load or building area so requires. Structural: engineering certification (memoria de cálculo / structural load inspection) validated by the municipal planning office or the Dirección de Gestión del Riesgo. Occupational: implementation of the SG-SST (Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo) registered with the Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), including risk assessment, emergency plan and first-aid supplies, under Ley 1562/2012 and Resolution 0312/2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official portal: muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign parent or non-resident investor establishes a Colombian S.A.S. through a notary public registration of the bylaws. The company must then register with DIAN through the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) using electronic filing procedures to obtain its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). If the foreign entity will operate directly without local incorporation, it must register for a NIT through the appointment of a legal representative or agent in Colombia, and the RUT will reflect the non-resident status and applicable tax regime. All registrations require prior creation of a user account on DIAN's MUISCA portal and digital certification (cédula digital or foreign equivalent file uploaded).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box election exists; a Colombian S.A.S. is a per-se corporation subject to entity-level tax under Colombian income tax law. No hybrid mismatch election is needed for ordinary domestic tax classification; when relevant, taxpayers may apply the election rules contained in applicable tax treaties or align with OECD hybrid mismatch provisions for cross-border structures, but no separate statutory election creates check-the-box transparency.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No minimum economic turnover threshold; any person or entity performing taxable sales of goods, services, or imports in Colombia must register as an IVA responsible party (responsable del IVA) on the RUT prior to commencing operations, except for persons falling under the simplified regime (Régimen Simplificado) who are expressly exempted by law and only for certain retail activities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All taxpayers classified as IVA responsible must invoice through DIAN-authorized electronic invoicing systems (factura electrónica). Invoices must be generated in real time and transmitted through DIAN's OAuth/API web services for validation and fiscal clearance, receiving a CUFE (Código Único de Factura Electrónica) or CUDE (for credit notes/related documents) and a QR-embedded digital stamp issued by DIAN. Software providers must be approved and enable XML generation, periodic batch validation, and the delivery of a validation response within DIAN operating windows; there is also a mandate for electronic transmission of all sales information in digital tax records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods sold from Colombian customs territory to a non-domiciled foreign buyer qualify for the 0% VAT rate only if physically exported and the exporter submits the corresponding customs export declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX) proving the goods left Colombia. Services provided from Colombia to a non-resident beneficiary, including digital platform support and subscription-commerce back-office services performed for a foreign principal, may be zero-rated as export services under Article 481 of the Colombian Tax Statute when the beneficiary is located abroad, the service is not principally used in Colombia, and all documentary requirements are met. The zero-rating is applied as a 20% imputed output VAT credit benefit in the period; actual refund of any input VAT is available through the periodic IVA declaration if properly substantiated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX), including the definitive export registration, modality code, and customs approval
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical goods movement from Colombian customs warehouse to a foreign port of destination

Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) issued by the bank proving inbound FX receipt within the mandatory repatriation period, or a certificate of non-payment when the operation is insurance/freight or otherwise exempt from FX surrender requirements
Commercial invoice issued under DIAN electronic invoicing rules
Packing list (for subscription box goods with multiple components)
Certificate of origin or proof of foreign destination when requested by DIAN
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN and customs authorities apply heightened scrutiny to export zero-rating claims. If the export declaration, physical shipment evidence, or FX repatriation certificate is missing, false, or incomplete, the VAT zero-rating is disallowed and the full 19% IVA is assessed on the transaction, plus interest. Fraudulent or abusive zero-rating claims trigger penalty under Article 67 of the Colombian Tax Statute (up to 160% of the evaded tax for egregious underpayment or false information), customs penalties under Decreto 920 and Law 1762 (sanctions up to 100% of the goods' value for false customs declarations), and the exporter may be targeted under tax-fraud criminal provisions (Articles 402 and 403 of the Criminal Code) if intention to evade is shown. The refund claim is also stayed until the exporter proves legal repatriation of FX, and clawback authority extends for the general limitation period (five years) for corrections by DIAN.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia), with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia as the enforcement authorities for exchange-market rules under Law 9 of 1991 and Resolution Externa 1 of 2018, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a partially liberalized, managed foreign-exchange regime. Current-account transactions (trade in goods, services, remittances) are freely convertible through authorized local exchange intermediaries. Capital-account transactions—including foreign direct investment in the S.A.S., external debt, and portfolio flows—require execution through the exchange market and registration under the appropriate Declaración de Cambio before Banco de la República. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders are legal but require: (i) prior registration of the direct investment; (ii) proof that Colombian income tax on the underlying profits has been paid; (iii) the corresponding foreign-exchange declaration filed through the intermediary; and (iv) applicable withholding tax to be deducted. The Colombian S.A.S. may lawfully receive USD/EUR equity contributions only through an authorized Colombian bank account, with the source of funds and purpose documented; the absence of a statutory minimum capital does not remove the exchange-registration duty for inward investment.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For S.A.S. exporters of physical goods, 100% of the gross export proceeds must be repatriated and channeled through the Colombian exchange market through an authorized intermediary within six months from the date of shipment (embarque). For exports of services, the six-month term runs from completion or contractual invoicing of the service, in line with Banco de la República regulations. The proceeds must be surrendered (i.e., sold to or credited through the exchange market) unless a specific exception authorizes retention in a registered foreign-currency account or compensation account abroad; exceptions require prior authorization and must be evidenced. Failure to comply triggers sanctions and renders the export documentary chain invalid for tax benefits.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a primary settlement and clearing rail; MEDIUM as an ancillary global wallet or payables card. An offshore digital EMI (e.g., Revolut Business, Airwallex, Wise Business) cannot act as an authorized exchange intermediary in Colombia and cannot open COP clearing accounts with local participation. Using an EMI as the principal route for export receivables violates the Colombian channeling rules and may lead to FX fines, blocked import/export declarations, and treasury control risk. The EMI may serve only for small, non-regulated USD/EUR working balances outside the Colombian merchant clearing chain, with all corresponding cross-border payments mirrored into the Colombian regulated banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no blanket Colombian statute requiring every director to appear physically before the bank. Under the Sarlaft (AML/CFT) regime, banks perform risk-based due diligence and may accept a remote/video-call interview for a low-risk S.A.S. client, particularly when the company has a regulated merchant card ecosystem. In practice, however, most tier-1 Colombian banks require one physical appearance by the statutory legal representative or, at a minimum, a notarized signature for account opening; foreign directors' identity documents and corporate powers must be apostilled and translated into Spanish. A capital escrow account normally triggers a longer review because the bank must confirm the foreign investor and the purpose of third-party credit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undocumented or indirect foreign-shareholder funding and opaque ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete group structure chart; certificates of incorporation and good standing from each shareholder/intermediate holding company; apostilled powers; audited or management financial statements; source-of-wealth statement; bank statements of the remitting account; and a no-suspicion letter from the remitting regulated bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value subscription-box transactions that create an irregular transaction profile versus the declared ISIC 4791 activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Public subscription terms and service agreements; live merchant dashboard evidence from Stripe Billing and Authorize.Net; customer churn/refund and chargeback ratios; PCI-DSS compliance attestation; future sales forecast; and sample storefront invoices showing the underlying box merchandise.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP exposure, negative media, or sanctions-list hits on any director or ultimate beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO forms with nationality, tax ID, residence and passport copies; written explanations and CVs for any hits; official results from Colombian Sarlaft and international negative lists (OFAC, UN, Interpol), and legal opinions when necessary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of a capital escrow account for a non-resident investor injection routed from a non-bank channel
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered shareholder ledger of the S.A.S.; capital call and board resolution; signed subscription agreement; the Declaración de Cambio filed with the authorized bank; and the relevant Banco de la República registration code showing direct investment.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign equity contributions must flow by SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the investing entity's regulated bank into the S.A.S.'s COP or USD account at a local authorized bank. The payment must bear the exchange-market concept code for direct investment and be reported to Banco de la República through the Declaración de Cambio by the end of the month after receipt. No capital injection should enter through merchant card rails or an offshore EMI; if the investor advances a shareholder loan, the loan must be registered as external credit and follow specific amortization rules. Supporting documents—capital call, board resolution, incorporation registry and investor passport/power of attorney—must remain with the bank file and the S.A.S.'s treasury records.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Cross-border payments for merchandise and foreign vendors are settled by SWIFT MT103 (customer transfers) or MT202 (bank-to-bank cover) via the Colombian bank's treasury desk. For high-value or new-supplier purchase orders, the S.A.S. should use a commercial documentary letter of credit issued under UCP600, payable at sight or by usance draft, with the supplier's bank receiving an authenticated SWIFT message and presentation documents. Domestic purchases of packing materials and logistics services may be paid through ACH Colombia/PSE; all import-related disbursements must be linked to the underlying DIAN import declaration and FX form so that the payment becomes a valid tax cost.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable Colombian peso (COP)/USD spot and forward contracts with local authorized commercial banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on COP/USD with supervised local or international counterparties
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (COP/USD) registered for capital-structure hedging
FX call/put options acquired from licensed Colombian banks and brokerage firms

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No sector-specific tax holiday for subscription-box commerce. Ordinary deductions, cost of sales, payroll, depreciation, DTA/foreign tax credits and VAT cost treatment apply. No reduced rate is available to an S.A.S. unless it qualifies under a narrow statutory incentive (e.g., new ‘orange economy’ companies) and meets DIAN conditions.
